tangentialFactors: The two sources in the live inventory concern events and totals outside Santander: documented incidents in Antioquia and Caquetá, and nationwide counts of killings of trans people. localsOnly: The inventory contains no Santander-specific measure addressed to residents: no departmental or municipal policy, service, protection programme or enforcement practice. outOfScopeNotes: Whether armed-group flyer campaigns or organised targeting documented elsewhere in Colombia have reached Santander is not sourced.
